_README: Baseline allowlist for scripts/detect-orphans.mjs. Each entry SUPPRESSES one known-intentional (or accepted-baseline) orphan so `npm run detect:orphans` exits 0 until a NEW, un-accepted orphan appears. knip-style 'unused' is not always dead — an entry here is a deliberate acceptance, not a blanket mute. Match key = `type` + `path`. Ratchet DOWN over time: every time one of these is wired or removed, delete its entry so the detector then ENFORCES that it stays connected. Adding a NEW major code unit without wiring it = a new finding = build fail (interconnectedness gate).

allow.reason: INTENTIONALLY orphaned-pending-recycle RIGHT NOW. The Data tab's SQL/Table editor is being re-architected onto per-site D1 (docs/data-platform-scope.md). DataPanel is the canonical case that motivated this detector — the exact 'substantial code disconnected from the UI' near-miss. NOTE: it currently reads as wired (imported in Workbench.client.tsx), so the detector may not flag it today; this entry is a pre-registered SENTINEL. ⚠️ MUST BE REMOVED from this allowlist the moment the SQL/Table editor is recycled — deleting it re-arms the detector to ENFORCE the reconnection (a re-orphaned DataPanel then fails the gate).
allow.remove_when: SQL/Table editor recycled onto per-site D1 (Data Platform re-arch).
